purpose: Verify the derivative-difference pressure-head observer against an exact same-endpoint temporal error on a manufactured semi-discrete Richards problem before any physical-envelope transfer claim.
pass_rules: All HeadCalc solves converge under unchanged 8/4 nonlinear controls and unchanged 1e-12 hard numerical balance controls.
Computed uniform BE endpoint agrees with analytic u_BE to a floating-point consistency bound derived only from machine epsilon and arithmetic scale, not a calibrated scientific tolerance.
Computed observer agrees with its analytic formula to the same floating-point consistency principle.
Discrete manufactured water balance closes using storage change, equal top/bottom gravity fluxes, and backward-Euler endpoint sink integration.
Analytic exact manufactured mass change equals the exact time-integrated manufactured sink.
rho>1 at all five frozen lambda*dt values and rho decreases strictly at every refinement.
Observer magnitude and exact local endpoint error each decrease strictly at every refinement.
O0 and O2 machine-readable outputs are identical.
what_C1_can_qualify: correct source-bound implementation of the derivative-difference observer algebra
exact temporal-error relation and asymptotic behavior on the manufactured semi-discrete ODE
compatibility of the observer with an unchanged mass-conservative backward-Euler principal state on this manufactured axis
what_C1_cannot_qualify: transfer of rho>=1 or any bound to nonlinear SWAP soil hydraulics
a production tolerance or F-KT09 normalization
next_if_pass: Freeze Gate C2 physical-envelope transfer characterization. Compare the same observer to source-bound same-endpoint error evidence without relabelling any finite BE endpoint as exact.
